title: Rules Resolution Failed
description: The engine encountered an unrecoverable error while resolving a game rule.
steps: Check server.log for the full stack trace and context.
Report the issue with the log snippet using the bug report flow.

title: Invalid Game State
description: The game state is internally inconsistent and cannot be safely continued.
steps: Roll back to the most recent snapshot from the admin panel.
If rollback fails, check server.log for the cause.

title: Database Connection Failed
description: The server Postgres instance could not be reached or rejected the connection.
steps: Check that the Postgres sidecar is running.
Restart the app — sidecars are respawned on launch.
Check server.log for the connection error detail.

title: Migration Failed
description: A database migration could not be applied at startup.
steps: Check server.log for the migration error.
Do not manually edit the database schema.
If the error persists after restart, report it as a bug.

title: Ruleset Version Mismatch
description: The app's SRD ruleset version does not match the version in the database.
steps: Ensure all players and the host are on the same app version.
Update the app if a newer version is available.

title: Snapshot Rollback Failed
description: The game state could not be restored from the selected snapshot.
steps: Try a different snapshot from the admin panel.
Check server.log for the rollback error detail.

title: WebSocket Auth Failed
description: A client connection was rejected due to an invalid or expired token.
steps: Have the player rejoin using the host's invite code.
Check that the host's session is still active.

title: Tunnel Init Failed
description: The Cloudflare Tunnel could not be established for remote player connections.
steps: Check your internet connection.
Restart the app to retry tunnel initialisation.
Local network play (same LAN) is unaffected by tunnel failures.

title: Invite Code Invalid
description: The invite code provided by a joining player was not recognised.
steps: Ensure the player is using the current session's invite code.
Generate a new invite code from the admin panel if needed.

title: LLM Provider Unavailable
description: The configured AI provider returned an error or could not be reached after retries.
steps: Check your API key is valid and has available credits.
Verify your internet connection if using a cloud provider.
Switch to a different provider in campaign settings.
If using Ollama, ensure the local server is running on port 11435.

title: LLM Output Validation Failed
description: The AI returned a response that did not pass schema validation after retries.
steps: The DM AI will pause and notify the host.
Resume the session — the AI will retry on the next event.
If failures persist, check server.log and report as a bug.

title: Context Overflow
description: The AI Specialist's context window was exceeded and could not be trimmed further.
steps: This may occur in very long sessions. Start a new session to reset context.
Report the issue if it occurs consistently early in a session.

title: Terrain Gen Failed
description: Procedural terrain generation encountered an unrecoverable error.
steps: Retry world generation from the campaign setup screen.
Check server.log for the generation error detail.

title: Placement Validation Failed
description: The AI DM placed an entity or object at an invalid location during world gen.
steps: Retry world generation — placement is seeded and may succeed on retry.
Report if it fails consistently with the same campaign seed.

title: World Gen Timeout
description: World generation did not complete within the allowed time window.
steps: Retry world generation from the campaign setup screen.
If using a cloud LLM provider, check for rate limiting in server.log.

title: Sidecar Crash
description: A required background process (Postgres or Redis) exited unexpectedly.
steps: Restart the app — sidecars are respawned automatically on launch.
Check server.log for the crash reason.
If Postgres crashed mid-session, the most recent snapshot is recoverable.

title: Electron IPC Failure
description: Communication between the renderer and the Electron main process failed.
steps: Restart the app.
Check client.log for the IPC error detail.

title: Safe Storage Failure
description: The API key could not be read from or written to Electron's encrypted storage.
steps: Re-enter your API key in campaign settings.
On macOS, check Keychain Access for BYO20 entries if the issue persists.
Check client.log for the storage error detail.
